lines.en: label dormwarssix6:
scene nikidatewar1

: Hello and welcome back to the Dorm Wars! If you’re seeing this, it means you’ve either paid for a subscription to our members only section or you’re illegally streaming this and harming the industry!
: I’m your host, Miku Maruyama, and I’m joined here now by Tsuneyo Tojo and two girls who are about to get busy with their hot mystery date! But who is that mystery date, Tsuneyo?!
scene nikidatewar2
: Tsuneyo?
: I did not realize I was supposed to know this information. Nor did I know I was going to be an announcer.
: I just stood over here because the three of you were doing it and it made me feel like I was also supposed to do that.
: Guess you really are part Japanese after all if you’re just gettin’ into lines without knowin’ what they’re for.
: Can we have, like...a hint maybe? Because, if it’s not going to be someone from class, I’m worried it might be Miss Watabe and I’m not sure how to keep my composure around her.
: I think it’s going to be Rin’s mom, personally.
scene nikidatewar3
: What?! That’s even worse! I don’t want to date my mom! We’re on shaky enough territory as is and I only just got my phone back!
: I’m just saying — there’s no way Miss Watabe would ever agree to this competition and it’d be pretty easy to trick your mom into doing it instead.
: There’s also the matter of Niki Nakayama having not made her appearance yet! Could it be that this is finally her time to shine?
scene nikidatewar4
: That would certainly be an interesting development, Miku! And an even more interesting parallel given who we’d normally be having this date with.
: The issue here is that, having only recently proclaimed her love for our very own teacher, I think it’d be a little too risky for Niki to get busy with a couple of high schoolers.
: We’re not...actually getting “busy” are we?
scene nikidatewar5
: Depends on how well the date goes, I guess.
: Are you worried that you may be ordered to have sexual intercourse with your mother?
: I’m more worried about how you can say things like that without throwing up. Miss Watabe doesn’t seem like that bad of a choice now, all things considered.
: Any other guesses? Kaori’s name’s already been thrown out off-camera, but what about somebody like Karin?! Wouldn’t be the first time she got some younger girl’s heart pumpin’!
scene nikidatewar6
: There’s also Imani herself we could be paired with, Miku! She’s taken over pretty much every other one of Sensei’s jobs. Wouldn’t be that surprising to have her tackle this one too!
: Other than her, I don’t know. Sana’s mom, I guess?
: That one...wouldn’t be bad. She’s nice.
: Or it could be me.
scene nikidatewar7
: Huh? I thought it was someone older?
: I am older than you.
: Someone not in the class.
: We’re not in class right now.
: She’s got a point! And who knows? Maybe it’s the right one!
scene nikidatewar8
: But maybe it’s not?! And maybe we’re in store for the surprise of a lifetime as both of our contestants are about to head into private hotel rooms to await their date.
: What happens next is up to them. So maybe somebody really will get busy tonight?
: We’re charging extra if that happens. And I don’t come cheap.
: Tell your mom I said hi.
: Please tell me it’s not my mom.
: Tsuneyo, please tell me it’s not my mom.
: Stay tuned, folks! We might even get a healthy servin’ of incest at this rate!
scene nikidatewar9
: So Niki is the one filling in for me in the date war? How’d you get her to agree with that?
: It was pretty easy from what I understand. I believe Miss Imai got her number from Noriko and the two of them sorted it out.
: And if I know anything about Nee-chan, I’m sure convincing her was as easy as just saying you were the normal pick, ultimately causing her to volunteer and deprive you of such an opportunity.
: So you’re putting Rin in a private room with Niki?
scene nikidatewar10
: Is that going to be a problem?
: Maybe. Maybe not. I just hope she doesn’t make the same mistake as me.
: I think Uta’s the one we should be more worried about.
: She is suddenly weaker around cute girls than Rin is, yeah. That’s probably even more true in private since she’s never had a hot girlfriend to get all of her sexual energy out on.
scene nikidatewar11
: She does have Sensei, though. But for some reason, he’s now treating both Uta and Rin the same way he used to treat me by perpetually not having sex with them because it’s funny or something.
: I forgot about that. That was funny.
: Maybe for you. For me, it was Hell.
scene nikidatewar12
: I can relate. There’s only been one boy I’ve ever wanted since I started thinking about boys and it wasn’t until just recently that I got to join the sex club at all. The struggle is real.
: We really have endured, haven’t we?
scene nikidatewar13
: What? Why are you both looking at me like that?
: I think it’s your turn to talk about the difficulties of not having sex with my big brother. Go on. We won’t judge.
: Yeah, that’s not going to happen.
scene nikidatewar14
: (Menacing dolphin gaze)
: Oh. The weird dolphin is suddenly back.
: That’s no weird dolphin. That’s just my weird sister.
scene nikidatewar15
: Fucking paparazzi. They finally get a god damn scandal out of me and this is the way they repay me? Paying so much attention to me that I need to wear shit like this just to get around them?
: That...is their job.
: Shut up, Otoha. One day, you’re going to be the one wearing a dolphin suit to get around them after you wind up falling in love with someone you shouldn’t.
: Haha. Me? Falling in love with someone I shouldn’t? Pfft. Like that would ever happen.
: It’ll probably just be Onii-chan at this rate. He can’t make his final choice in life until he samples all of the available merchandise.
scene nikidatewar16
: Right! Which is the other reason I’m here! To deprive him of the opportunity to cheat on me with two more teenage girls!
: See? What’d I say?
: Have you already been filled in on the specifics, Niki? Or should I-
: Why are you not more excited to see me? Be more excited to see me.
: Uhh...kyaaaahhh...Have you already been filled in on the specifics?
scene nikidatewar17
: Rooms 308 and 309. Go in, watch them suffer, deliver judgement. Easy-peasy.
scene nikidatewar18
: Hi, Niki.
: Don’t talk to me, fuckface. I’m still mad at you.
: I understand. I’m sorry.
: Wow.
: Yeah. Nee-chan’s got him whipped now.
: This is all Peter Gabriel’s fault when you really think about it.
: No, it’s your fault for fucking my little sister. And probably this girl too. What’s your name again?
scene nikidatewar19
: Me? Makoto Miyamura.
: Well, have you been- wait. Are you the same girl who works in the porn shop?
: Oh, look. You’re also famous now, Makoto.
: I have been known to sell adult toys and videos, yes. But don’t worry. Store policy says I need to keep all of your purchases confidential.
: Uhh...thanks. That-
: Your many...many purchases.
scene nikidatewar20
: I....I was alone for a really long time, okay?!
: Don’t feel bad, Nee-chan. I’m a pervert too.
: And I am leaving. There’s food upstairs, yeah?
scene nikidatewar21
: Wait, take me with you. I need to change into my regular clothes and I don’t have an elevator key.
: Fine, just don’t change in front of me.
: I won’t. I’ve learned my lesson.
: So, what can you tell me about these girls that-
: She barely acknowledged my existence.
: Sure she did. She just...didn’t do it directly for the most part. It’s a step in the right direction though, isn’t it?
: If that direction is emotionally isolating Sensei in order to make him repent, then yes.
: I think that’s the exact direction she’s going for, yeah.
: I don’t mind her walking all over me if it keeps her close.
scene nikidatewar22
: Wow. What an interesting outlook that I definitely don’t relate to at all.
: She’ll settle down soon enough, Onii-chan. She got the worst of it out of her system already. From this point on it’s just adapting and coping.
: You think so?
: Mhm. It’s only a matter of time until she’s in the same boat as us.
scene black
: Tired. Resigned. Desperate. And a million other things that combine to create the burdens we must bear in order to be with you.
: How deep.
: If you think that’s deep, you should see his penis inside of me. I’m really skinny, so it kind of pokes out of my belly and-
: Thank you for the imagery, but I have seen the same thing myself. I was commenting more on your brutally honest outlook for our...romantic potential.
: Oh, speaking of which — how do you think Rin and Uta are going to do?
scene nikidatewar23
: There’s only one way to find out, really.
: Tapping into the hidden cameras you guys installed in each of their rooms?
: Right. I hope you’re good at lip-reading though, because there’s no audio feed.
: That’s fine. We don’t need one to watch them have sex.
: It’s going to be your sister in there, you know.
: I just want to make sure she’s doing it correctly.
: Hah...
: Please don’t be my mom. Please don’t be my mom. Please don’t be my mom.
scene nikidatewar24
: Mmmh! Me first?! Really?!
scene nikidatewar25
: W...Whatever! You can do this, Rin! You’ve had sex with a girl before! Two girls, actually! Even if one of those times happened out of literally nowhere and-
: Should I do the other girl first? You seem to need a little more time to prepare.
scene nikidatewar26
: No, you can do me now! Three girls is fine! I’m still not very experienced, though! And I don’t know how to top!
scene nikidatewar27
: That...is fine. I was talking more about the whole “dating” thing than literally doing you. But I guess it’s nice being...confident and prepared?
: N...Niki?! Wait, did you really agree to-
scene nikidatewar28
: Oh, hey! I remember you. Otoha’s girlfriend.
: Uhh...ex-girlfriend. We’ve been broken up for a long time now. Do you...really remember me? Because I remember you. Obviously. But I...me...I didn’t think you’d-
scene nikidatewar29
: Deep breaths, okay? We’ve already met before. And I really am just a regular girl at the end of the day.
scene nikidatewar30
: You? Regular? Hahahaha. Yeah. Right. Like I can convince myself of that under pressure in a private hotel room that everybody told me we were going to “get busy” in.
scene nikidatewar31
: Is that what you want? To “get busy” with me?
: Uhhhhhhhhhhhh................nooooooo?
: Good. Because that’s a terrible way to start off a date and not something I’m interested in. What else have you got?
: J...Just my...body...I...have little else...to...offer you...mnh!
: Hey. Look at me.
: That’s a bad idea.
: How come? You should be experienced after all. You’ve had sex with two whole girls. Even if one of those times happened out of literally nowhere and-
scene nikidatewar32
: Aaaaahhhhh nooooo! You weren’t supposed to hear my mantra! Who the heck chose a hotel room for a first date?! This is terrible!
: How have you been? Did my protege let you down gently, at least?
scene nikidatewar33
: It...sucked at first, but...we’re friends now. We just...wanted something different, I guess...
: And that was your first break-up, I’m guessing?

: It was...yeah. My only break-up too. Kind of. I don’t really...know. There was a second one too but, like...we weren’t technically together? And it was also a confession at the same time? I don’t get it.
: Love can be a pretty confusing thing, huh? I had my first break-up not too long ago too, you know.
scene nikidatewar34
: You...did? So...was there someone you were with before Sensei? Or-
: No. It’s always been him. He just did something I couldn’t forgive him for recently and the two of us went on a bit of a break for it.
: But you’re...back together now...right?
: Right. Which I am not happy about, but...it is what it is, I guess.
: Well, I’m...sorry if this sounds rude, but...you look happy. Is that not because of him?
: No, it is.
: Then...what? He makes you miserable and happy and...you can’t forgive him, but you forgave him and took him back?
: None of it makes sense, I know.
scene nikidatewar35
: But that just goes to show I’m human, doesn’t it? We all do stuff from time to time that defies logic since that’s what it means to love somebody.
: I...I see...
: Did you love Otoha?
scene nikidatewar36
: I...thought I did. I’m not so sure in hindsight, though. Like...my feelings for her were really strong, sure. But I don’t think they were...as strong as they are for someone else.
: Girl number two?
: Girl number two in a way and...and also boy number one.
: So there’s a boy now too? You’re pretty popular, huh?

: Being popular would mean that boy number one liked me back, but I’m not...sure if he actually does. And girl number two also likes him, so it’s just a whole big mess that I don’t know what to do about.
: Well, seeing as this is way more fun than roleplaying some kind of date with you, I’ll happily give you as much advice as you want. Assuming you want any that is.
: I just can’t guarantee it’ll be good advice since I think, technically speaking, you’ve already had more relationships than I’ve ever had.
scene nikidatewar37
: So Sensei’s really...the only person you’ve ever had feelings for?
: I think it’s a disease some childhood friends catch if they develop crushes too early. But yeah. He’s the only one for me, as shitty as it is to admit that.
: What are the downsides, though? Just that he’s...unfaithful and emotionally closed off? And has a hard time accepting and understanding what it means to love in the first place?
scene nikidatewar38
: You know him pretty well, huh?
: I do...
: We were really close once upon a time, but...a lot of stuff happened and we sort of grew apart. And we’ve been getting closer again lately, but now there’s this other girl who-
: He’s boy number one, isn’t he?
: Don’t hit me. Yes.
scene nikidatewar39
: Hah...Why would I hit you, Rin?
: Because we’re alone in a private room and I just kind of told you I have a crush on your boyfriend.
: Who doesn’t? At least you haven’t actually slept with him. Which, and please don’t take this as a good sign because I don’t want to encourage you, might actually work out in your favor.
scene nikidatewar40
: Huh? What do you-
: What I mean is that he’s apparently decided to protect you instead of ruin you. Noriko was the same way until recently. That’s what we broke up over.
: Noriko isn’t ruined, though. She-
: No, I know she isn’t. She’s stronger than me. Stronger than I’ll ever be, probably. And I get what Akira sees in her but, at the same time, there has to be some sort of “line.” You know?
: I do. And I don’t have a sister but, if I did, I imagine I’d feel the same way as you. The part I don’t really get is why not paying attention to me is somehow a good thing.
scene nikidatewar41
: Well, he’s not avoiding you, is he?
: No, but-
: Then just trust me. As someone who knows him better than anyone, you’re in a good spot right now.
scene nikidatewar42
: As his girlfriend, though, that makes you my rival!
: I...I feel a very...dark energy coming from you right now...
: Good!
scene nikidatewar43
: Because one of the main reasons I wanted to go public about my love for him in the first place is to cut all of you down where you stand.

: You’re still just a kid, Rin. Go after girl number two or literally anyone your own age. All chasing after that asshole will do is ruin both of your lives. And you’re too cute to blow yourself up, I think.
: But what if I...
: What if I want to...blow up?
scene nikidatewar44
: What if I want to feel the pain that comes from having my heart broken? What if I want to hurt instead of just dreaming about all of the things out there that could hurt me?

: Because most days, I don’t feel anything. But when I’m with him, there’s like...there’s a voice in the back of my head egging me on. Telling me to jump. Telling me that if I don’t, I’ll be stuck up here forever.

: And I don’t want that....I want to live. I want to want to live. And if there’s some sort of obstacle in my way, shouldn’t I be trying to overcome it rather than just waiting for an easier path like I’ve always done?
: If he’s the thing that gives me a chance to experience love or joy or whatever it is I’m chasing, then getting hurt isn’t just a side effect. It’s the whole point. It means I’m here. I feel. I am.
scene nikidatewar45
: Or I could be...
: But right now, I’m not. Right now, I’m any other girl in any other room, waiting for the right person to walk through the door. But that person isn’t you, so...I...
: I think I need to drop out of this competition.
: I think I...don’t want to win.
scene nikidatewar46
: Okay, okay. Hold your horses.
: I don’t have any horses. I think you have me confused with Touka.
: No, I just meant that Akira is still the “prize” or whatever if your floor comes out on top, right? Your other teacher told me all about it.
: Well...yes. But-
scene nikidatewar47

: I’m not going to sit here any longer and give you advice on how to proceed with your own life. I barely know you. You barely know me. And even if we’re rivals, I’m not going to tell you to stop following your heart.
: Besides, your head’s screwed on a lot tighter than mine ever was at your age. It’s kind of cool, actually.
: You...think I’m cool?
: Yeah. I can see what Otoha saw in you. And what Akira probably does too since age is just a meaningless fucking number to him.
: I’m sorry for...falling for him. I tried to stop it. I really did.
: It’s fine. I don’t blame you at all.
: I just hope the next girl is a little more infatuated with me. I could use the confidence boost right now.
scene nikidatewar48
: Uta-chan — engage! There’s no need for regular ole’ Uta in here!
: The time has come to wear your big girl pants and turn the charm on so you can win additional quality time  with the boy you like! Even if that boy is not the one you get to date today!
scene nikidatewar49
: Just think of it like another shift at the cafe. You talk to pretty girls all the time. What could possibly go wrong?
: Ahem.
scene nikidatewar50
: Heh?
scene nikidatewar51
: Hi.
scene nikidatewar52
: I needed that.
scene black
scene nikidatewar53
: Mnh...
: What the?...
scene nikidatewar54
: When did I...hit my head?...
scene nikidatewar55
: Is the...competition-
scene nikidatewar56
scene black
scene nikidatewar57
: This is not what it looks like.
: Are you sure?
: Because it can be what it looks like.
: That-
: Misunderstandings can lead to good things too.
scene nikidatewar58
: You fainted! I was just helping you get into bed!
: Oh.
: Yeah!
: Well...I think I need more help with other stuff now.
: Other stuff?! Like what?!
: I don’t know if I should say it out loud.
scene nikidatewar59
: Yeah, so, Rin wins.
: Jesus, Uta. Just how badly did you drop the ball? I literally tried to quit.
: I don’t want to talk about it. Ever. For the rest of my life.
: They call that the Niki effect. I used to have to hand out water bottles and cold compresses to all of the girls who’d faint at Nee-chan’s handshake events.
: The hell happened in Uta’s room? Girl looks like she just hopped out of the sauna.
: What a coincidence. That is also how I feel.
scene nikidatewar60
: Noriko.
: One bottle of water and a cold compress coming right up!
scene nikidatewar61
: Okay! So if Niki is confident that Rin is the winner tonight, it brings our day one tally to 3-2 in favor of the first floor!
: Who are you talking to?
: Any words for our members, Rin?
scene nikidatewar62
: Just...that I’m very thankful there was no audio feed in the hotel room.
: Same. Big same.
: Seriously, though. There’s no one there.
